claude_proposed_widenings.name: AreaSaveGateOperation
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Insect Plague's persistent damage is delivered via a save gate that fires when a creature enters the area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. OngoingOperation only has roll_modifier and damage_on_hit variants; neither encodes a save gate triggered by area interaction. A new SaveGateOnAreaInteractionOperation variant is needed with: ability, dc, onFail effect, onSuccess effect, and a trigger kind (enters_or_ends_turn). All required v4 atoms (save_gate, area, damage, persist/expire) already exist.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: A creature also makes this save when it enters the spell's area for the first time on a turn or ends its turn there. A creature makes this save only once per turn.

discrepancies: no content/insect_plague.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
